source: It feels like I’m walking through a painting I’ve seen a thousand times. I know every color of the world, every building in the background, the vague smell of dogwood trees and gasoline, people moving with their eyes on their smartphones. It’s a familiar picture of home. Asbury Pines. And yet, it feels unreal. A depiction of what’s real. Like I’m watching life happen to everything else but me. I imagine this is how ghosts may feel. May 4, 2034. I have a day to complete my task. It’s a beautiful afternoon. Tuesday. When’s the last time in Asbury Pines I stopped to enjoy a Tuesday? The wig does wonders, or is that I don’t have my signature eyepatch on? No one in town recognized me on my long walk from the town hall to the cheap aluminum bleachers by Asbury High’s sports fields. Even nosy old Wilma Truitt, out watering her gas station shrubs, didn’t shoot me her familiar fake smile. If I remember correctly, right now I’d be grabbing groceries before Danny gets home from coaching the varsity soccer team… what were they called… ah, right, go Gray Wolves. Aaaaooo…. My heart skips. There he is. Jogging out. My husband. Love of my life. He glances my way, double takes. I lower my head into my book. His gaze melts me like a marshmallow. I want his arms around me. I want to cry into his chest and tell him I love him a million times. You knew this would be hard, Ev. Remember what you learned. Go now. Let’s get something to eat and then see the kids.
target: 感觉像走进一幅看过千百遍的画。我认得世界的每种颜色、背景里的每栋建筑、山茱萸与汽油淡淡的气味，还有人们盯着手机走路的样子。这是熟悉的家乡景象。阿斯伯里松林镇。可它又如此不真实。像真实的摹本。仿佛我看着生命在所有人身上发生，唯独没有我。我想，鬼魂也许就是这种感觉。 2034 年 5 月 4 日。我有一天时间完成任务。 美丽的午后。星期二。上次我在阿斯伯里松林镇停下来，享受一个星期二，是什么时候？ 假发真有效，还是因为我没戴那个招牌眼罩？从市政厅一路走到阿斯伯里高中运动场旁的廉价铝制看台，镇上没有人认出我。就连正在替加油站灌木浇水、爱管闲事的老威尔玛・特鲁伊特，都没对我露出那熟悉的假笑。没记错的话，现在的我应该在采买，赶在丹尼结束校队足球训练回家前买好东西……球队叫什么来着……啊，对，灰狼队加油。嗷呜…… 我的心漏跳一拍。他在那里。慢跑出来。我的丈夫。我一生的挚爱。他朝我瞥了一眼，又回头看。我低下头，把脸埋进书里。他的目光让我像棉花糖一样融化。 我想要他的双臂抱住我。我想伏在他胸口哭，告诉他一百万次我爱他。 妳早知道这会很难，艾芙。 记住妳学到的一切。 现在走吧。去吃点东西，再看看孩子们。

source: I want to believe there’s another way. An angle I haven’t considered. Do I have to die? Do I HAVE to kill me? You knew your mind would do this… the motions of grief… painful negotiation… Seeing my kids today… you knew it would be torture, Ev — you knew. And you went anyway, watched them all have dinner. Grinning Gavin and his cheeky smile, Heather the jitterbug bopping in her chair, Danny getting mashed potatoes in his beard, and you, Ev, actually laughing with them. For a moment I was her. I was in there with them. I was bursting joy. I was home. But, yes, you held. You tore yourself away from the window, the view of everything you wanted. That took a lot of fucking strength, Ev. And you slinked through the yard and hid behind the shed and waited. Sobbed and waited long after the houses around you flipped off the lights. You held to what you had to do. When the moon was past midnight and you were sure the family and neighbors were asleep, you took the shed’s spare key under the big clay pot of dirt you never used and felt through the options inside. Rake. Hedge trimmer. Shovel. Trowel. Hammer. Ax. And you stayed strong and locked up, and brought the ax back to the woods. Though dark, the day is almost here. The day of days. Remember, present-day Everly made a resolution a month ago to run at dawn before the kids get up. For health. For the dopamine. For another edge over depression. She’ll run right by the edge of the park. Cry now. It’s okay. Cry and wail and argue and moan. Let it out, Ev, so that you’re ready for the day.
target: 我想相信还有别的办法。一个我没想过的角度。我非死不可吗？我非得杀死自己吗？ 妳早知道脑袋会这样……悲伤的反复……痛苦地讨价还价…… 今天看见孩子们……妳早知道那会是折磨，艾芙——妳知道。可妳还是去了，看着他们全家吃晚餐。 盖文咧着嘴，露出淘气的笑；海瑟像只小跳豆，在椅子上晃来晃去；丹尼胡子上沾了马铃薯泥；而妳，艾芙，竟然和他们一起笑着。有一瞬间，我就是她。我就在里面，和他们在一起。喜悦满得快要炸开。我回家了。 但，是的，妳撑住了。妳硬是让自己离开窗边，离开那幅妳渴望的一切。 那他妈需要好大的力气，艾芙。 妳悄悄穿过院子，躲到工具间后面，等待。妳哭着等，直到四周人家早已熄灯。妳守住了自己非做不可的事。 月亮走过午夜，妳确定家人与邻居都睡了，便从那个装着土、却从没用过的大陶盆底下，拿出工具间的备用钥匙，在里面摸索可用的东西。耙子。篱笆剪。铲子。小铲。铁锤。斧头。 妳仍然坚强，锁好门，把斧头带回树林。 天还黑着，但那一天就快到了。最重要的那一天。 记住，现在的艾芙莉一个月前下定决心，要在孩子起床前的黎明跑步。为了健康。为了多巴胺。为了多一点对抗忧郁的力量。她会跑过公园边缘。 现在哭吧。没关系。哭泣、嚎啕、争辩、哀鸣。 把一切宣泄出来，艾芙，好让妳准备好面对这一天。

source: Future Everly: We.. we’ve never been ones to feel this about ourselves, but you should hear it. I know we’re numb to happiness when we don’t want to be. I know we’re depressed crybabies putting on a face for the ones we love. I know we don’t accomplish anything worthy of history books. But that doesn’t matter to me because I know this too: we’re good moms. The world runs on good moms. The world is saved by good moms. Good moms who are scared shitless, broken down, and struggling with mental health. Good moms who want to curl up into a ball in the darkest corner of the attic, but instead cook fried chicken and mashed potatoes, tease out giggles from the kids, and blow kisses to dad. Good moms are not getting any monuments and I’m okay with that. So I want you to hear it at least once from the person in the mirror. I want you to hear what I never had the courage to tell myself. Everly Praetis, I’m proud of us and I love you.
target: 未来的艾芙莉：我们……我们从来不会这样看自己，但妳应该听见。我知道，我们明明不想这样，却对快乐麻木。我知道，我们是忧郁的爱哭鬼，为了所爱的人强颜欢笑。我知道，我们没做出值得写进史书的成就。但我不在乎，因为我也知道：我们是好妈妈。世界靠好妈妈运转。世界靠好妈妈拯救。那些吓得要死、身心崩溃、苦苦与心理困境搏斗的好妈妈。那些想蜷缩在阁楼最黑暗角落，却仍做炸鸡和马铃薯泥、逗孩子咯咯笑、对爸爸飞吻的好妈妈。没有人会替好妈妈立纪念碑，我也能接受。所以，我希望妳至少有一次，能从镜中那个人口中听见。我想让妳听见，我一直没勇气对自己说的话。艾芙莉・普雷蒂斯，我为我们骄傲，我爱妳。

source: Present Everly: Danny’s calling. What do I say? What am I supposed to say?
target: 现在的艾芙莉：丹尼打来了。我该说什么？我到底该说什么？

source: Present Everly: I’m shaking too much. I’m so tense. Just knock me out first. Position my neck on the stump however is best and then do it.
target: 现在的艾芙莉：我抖得太厉害了。我好紧绷。先把我打昏吧。把我的脖子放在树桩上，怎样最好就怎样，然后动手。

source: Present Everly: And this Quent place is a human paradise?
target: 现在的艾芙莉：所以，昆特那个地方是人类的天堂？

source: Present Everly: So that’s a robo-eye like from Terminator? Not just a prosthetic little marble?
target: 现在的艾芙莉：所以，那是像《魔鬼终结者》里的机器眼？不只是颗小玻璃珠义眼？

source: Future Everly: "Come with me if you want to live.” Heh, yep, it takes in complex visual data that’s translated to the particular neural stimulation recognized by the optic nerve, and the occipital lobe does the rest. No pain receptors – check it out: *tap, tap, tap*.
target: 未来的艾芙莉：「想活命就跟我走。」呵，对，它接收复杂的视觉资料，转换成视神经能辨识的特定神经刺激，剩下的交给枕叶。没有痛觉受器——妳看：＊叩、叩、叩＊。

source: Future Everly: We need to be strong, Ev. Tell him you feel great. The run was exactly what you needed and you went to grab your favorite spinach and ham omelet from Dory’s Diner. He will like it… hearing you happy…
target: 未来的艾芙莉：我们得坚强，艾芙。告诉他，妳觉得很棒。这趟跑步正是妳需要的，妳跑去多莉餐馆买最爱的菠菜火腿欧姆蛋。他会高兴的……听见妳开心……

source: Present Everly: So… so why? Why are you forcing me into the woods with an ax?
target: 现在的艾芙莉：那……那为什么？妳为什么拿着斧头，逼我进树林？

source: Future Everly: As smooth as possible. The bionic eye has been miraculous for my hand-eye coordination. It’s all about the precision of the slice, the angle of the cut, where the blade meets the muscle tissue and bone.
target: 未来的艾芙莉：我会尽可能俐落。仿生眼让我的手眼协调好得不可思议。关键在于落刀的精准度、切入的角度，以及刀刃接触肌肉组织与骨头的位置。

source: Present Everly: You’ll chop me clean, right? Quick.
target: 现在的艾芙莉：妳会俐落地砍下去，对吧？快一点。

source: Present Everly: God…
target: 现在的艾芙莉：天啊……

source: Present Everly: Why won’t you put the ax down? Why won’t you promise that you won’t hurt me? If you’re actually me, then you know I have—
target: 现在的艾芙莉：妳为什么不放下斧头？为什么不答应不伤害我？如果妳真的是我，就知道我有——

source: Present Everly: It’s not fair, though. Why is the greatest thing in the world only happening because we die? How can that be right?
target: 现在的艾芙莉：可这不公平。为什么世界上最美好的事，非得因为我们死了才会发生？这怎么会是对的？

source: Future Everly: No. No, Ev. I almost wish it were. Like I said, I’m you but from the future of this town, our world. Here, toss me your necklace, the green gem pendant from Danny. Yes, I know all about it. Now watch…
target: 未来的艾芙莉：不。不是，艾芙。我几乎希望这只是恶作剧。就像我说的，我是妳，只是来自这个镇子、这个世界的未来。来，把项链丢给我，丹尼送的绿宝石坠炼。对，我全都知道。现在看着……

source: Present Everly: I don’t want this. Not at all. I want what’s best. I trust us.
target: 现在的艾芙莉：我不想要这样。一点都不想。我想要最好的结果。我相信我们。

source: Present Everly: Ha, cool. Look at me go with that fancy medical talk. I sure got smart, huh?
target: 现在的艾芙莉：哈，真酷。瞧我，连这么厉害的医学术语都会说了。我变聪明了，对吧？

source: Present Everly: This… this is a sick fucking prank, right?
target: 现在的艾芙莉：这……这是他妈有病的恶作剧，对吧？

source: Future Everly: All thanks to our great-great-great grandkid. He came up with Exomnus, that language I was telling you about. The purest language for learning. Once your mind calibrates to it, pretty much anything you want to know gets delivered in the simplest, purest, most resonant way.
target: 未来的艾芙莉：全靠我们的曾曾曾孙。他创造了艾克索姆语，就是我跟妳说过的那种语言。最纯粹的学习语言。一旦脑袋适应它，几乎所有想知道的事，都能以最简单、最纯粹、最能引起共鸣的方式传达。

source: THE TALK
target: 那场谈话

source: Future Everly: As far as I know, it’s the closest we get to anything resembling paradise. The people aren’t like here. In Quent they prioritize each other, and innovation is meant to maximize freedom, curiosity, and learning. If you ask me, Danny’s the one to thank for that. His ideas about—
target: 未来的艾芙莉：据我所知，那是我们最接近天堂的地方。那里的人和这里不同。昆特的人把彼此放在首位，创新是为了尽可能增进自由、好奇心与学习。要我说，这都该感谢丹尼。他那些关于——

source: Future Everly: Oh, don’t start crying or I’ll start crying…
target: 未来的艾芙莉：噢，别哭，妳哭了我也会哭……

source: Present Everly: What the fuck?! What did you do?
target: 现在的艾芙莉：搞什么鬼？！妳做了什么？

source: Future Everly: I opened a time portal – I know, sounds crazy. But this is what I once went through to end up in the future. This gem is the key to opening a temporal… uggh, I can only imagine how this sounds. Like something out of a super hero movie. I know your shock and your confusion. I really do. I was you. I still am you.
target: 未来的艾芙莉：我开了一道时间传送门——我知道，听起来很疯狂。但我就是穿过这个，才到了未来。这颗宝石是开启时间……唉，我只能想像这听起来有多荒唐，像超级英雄电影里的东西。我知道妳有多震惊、多困惑。真的。我曾经就是妳。我现在仍然是妳。

source: Present Everly: “Hey babe! Yeah, real good actually. Thanks for wrangling the kiddos, you’re the absolute best. I mean it…”
target: 现在的艾芙莉：「嗨，亲爱的！嗯，其实真的很好。谢谢你照顾那两个小家伙，你是最棒的。真的……」

source: Present Everly: Me too, Everly Praetis. I love you too.
target: 现在的艾芙莉：我也是，艾芙莉・普雷蒂斯。我也爱妳。

source: Future Everly: Wait, stand up. Look me in the eye and tell me you want this.
target: 未来的艾芙莉：等等，站起来。看着我的眼睛，告诉我妳想要这样。

source: Future Everly: Sorry.
target: 未来的艾芙莉：对不起。

source: Future Everly: I need you to listen to our story. I want you to know everything I learned about us in the 10 years I spent in the future. But I’ll start with you, with the earliest memory we share. Ever since we can remember, we had trouble sleeping because we felt like we weren’t normal…
target: 未来的艾芙莉：我要妳听听我们的故事。我想让妳知道，我在未来那十年间学到的、关于我们的一切。但我要从妳开始，从我们共有的最早记忆开始。从有记忆以来，我们就很难入睡，因为总觉得自己不正常……

source: Future Everly: It’s not right. It just is. I hate that the calculations, as many times as I checked, were never wrong. I hate that we’re dealing with facts. And I hate that I had the time and space to process all this while you have to bear it now, fully, under a ticking clock.
target: 未来的艾芙莉：这不是对的。它只是事实。我恨那些计算，不管检查多少次，都从没错过。我恨我们面对的是事实。我也恨，我有时间和空间消化这一切，妳却得在此刻，在时间一秒秒流逝时，承受全部。

source: Present Everly: But how have you gotten this far? You studied for like 10 years. You came back to my time. You got an ax. You stalked me and forced me out here. How were you able to say “yes” at every step?
target: 现在的艾芙莉：可妳怎么能走到这一步？妳学了差不多十年。回到我的时代。拿了斧头。跟踪我，逼我来这里。妳怎么能在每一步都说「好」？

source: Future Everly: We can stop here by the abandoned grave. I know you just ran, so feel free to sit on that stump over there.
target: 未来的艾芙莉：我们可以在这座荒废的坟墓旁停下。我知道妳刚跑完步，想坐就坐那边的树桩。

source: Future Everly: Ev, I’m never going to disagree that this isn’t a horrible situation. It’s literally the worst hand we can be dealt by destiny. It’s devastatingly cruel. Oh, sure, let me start raising a family and then kill myself so that my descendants can go through a bunch of unimaginable pain and suffering and bullshit to save humanity. Even with all the time I had to deal with this idea, I’m frustrated to the bone!
target: 未来的艾芙莉：艾芙，我绝不会否认这是个可怕的处境。这真的是命运能发给我们最烂的一手牌。残酷得让人崩溃。噢，好啊，先让我成家、养孩子，然后自杀，好让后代历经一堆难以想像的痛苦、磨难与烂事，去拯救人类。就算有那么多时间面对这个念头，我仍然憋屈得要命！

source: Future Everly: You know, I never told anyone this, but fuck humanity. I don’t care about Quent or paradise. I definitely don’t care about society’s progress more than my family. I’m not some time-traveling hero version of yourself bent on saving the human race. I’m you. I’m a mom. And I can’t fathom loving anything more than Danny and the kids. So knowing about all the shit that’s going to happen to this world… knowing that Danny will shape amazing people… knowing that they’ll make it through… knowing that they’ll be the best versions of us… knowing all THAT is why I’m here. I’m a mom doing what I think is best. I’m protecting our family based on everything I know. That’s it. That’s why I’m okay with being here with an ax.
target: 未来的艾芙莉：妳知道吗，我从没跟任何人说过，但去他妈的人类。我不在乎昆特，也不在乎天堂。我绝不会把社会进步看得比家人重要。我不是什么穿越时空、一心拯救人类的英雄版的妳。我就是妳。我是个妈妈。我无法想像，自己会爱任何东西胜过丹尼和孩子。所以，知道这个世界将发生那些烂事……知道丹尼会教养出那么棒的人……知道他们会撑过去……知道他们会成为最好的我们……知道这一切，才是我来这里的原因。我只是个妈妈，在做自己认为最好的事。根据我所知道的一切，保护我们的家人。就这样。所以，我才能接受自己拿着斧头站在这里。

source: Future Everly: Two kids, Gav and Heth. Both delivered by C-section. Gavin in March 23, 2024 and Heather on September 9, 2022. A wonderful husband, Danny. Highschool sweetheart. Loves bratwurst. His ears are super ticklish. Left one has a freckle on the lobe that looks like a stud earring. I know everything about us…
target: 未来的艾芙莉：两个孩子，盖文和海瑟。都是剖腹产。盖文是 2024 年 3 月 23 日，海瑟是 2022 年 9 月 9 日。很棒的丈夫，丹尼。高中时的恋人。爱吃德式香肠。耳朵超怕痒。左耳耳垂有颗雀斑，看起来像耳钉。关于我们，我全都知道……

source: Present Everly: I’m supposed to be okay with traumatizing my entire family? Danny and the kids will be crushed. Like, emotionally fucked up for life!
target: 现在的艾芙莉：要让全家人受创，还要我觉得没关系？丹尼和孩子们会崩溃。心里会他妈的一辈子都好不了！

source: Everly Praetis. Ten years ago now, and still… she’s still up in the ole attic of my memories. Godforsaken. No other word for it. A murder so brutal it made the whole town of Asbury Pines look itself in the mirror. We work, we raise kids, we do our best, we let time run its course, and then we’re still left scratchin’ our heads. Why did this evil have to happen? Why’s the good so damn hard to be come by? Even lady law has traded in decency for body armor and hairpin triggers. Feels like it’s all goin’ to hell. I suppose that’s always been the case. Granddad said it, Pa said it, and I bet the kids will say it after we pass. I’ll even bet that the cavemen and Cherokee and Nathaniel Asbury and the rich Sloan family – everyone before us said it, and then everyone after us will. Like it’s some sort of truth. Truth’s gotta be honest, though. Truth is the bad and its also a chickadee whistling its pretty ditty. It’s a good plate of biscuits and gravy from Dory’s Diner. It’s smiling at the Halloween parade. It’s smelling summer barbecues and decorating Grand Rosa. It’s kissin’ my wife on the forehead before bed… It’s seeing Everly’s sweet kids and knowing in your heart she was a special mom… Yeah. I think that’s why she sticks with me. When I remember Everly Praetis, I remember the evil. And then I remember why we all oughta keep tryin’.
target: 艾芙莉・普雷蒂斯。已经十年了，她却仍然……仍然住在我记忆的老阁楼里。 天理不容。找不到别的词。那桩凶杀残暴得让整个阿斯伯里松林镇都不得不照照镜子。我们工作、养孩子、尽力而为，任时间自行流淌，到头来却仍只能抓着头困惑。为什么偏要发生这种恶事？ 美好怎么就这么难得？连执法者都把良知换成了防弹衣和一触即发的扳机。 感觉一切都在往地狱去。 我想，一直都是这样吧。祖父说过，爸爸说过，我敢打赌，等我们走了，孩子们也会这么说。我甚至敢打赌，穴居人、切罗基人、纳撒尼尔・阿斯伯里，还有富裕的斯隆家族——我们之前的每个人都说过，我们之后的每个人也会说。仿佛那是某种真理。 可真相得诚实才行。真相是那些坏事，也是山雀吹着好听的小调。是多莉餐馆一盘美味的比司吉淋肉汁。是在万圣节游行时微笑。是闻着夏日烤肉香，装饰大罗莎。是睡前亲吻妻子的额头…… 是看着艾芙莉那两个可爱的孩子，心里明白，她是个特别的妈妈…… 对。我想，这就是她一直留在我心里的原因。 想起艾芙莉・普雷蒂斯时，我想起那份邪恶。然后，我想起了我们为什么都该继续努力。

source: Aahck! Would flip through air with joy for just one day with no wind! Sunup to sundown, wind from the West. Five seasons of wind. Not storm wind, not breeze wind. Wind steady and firm. Blowing the water away more and more. Takes much strength to fly with old bones and frayed feathers. Nest so boring. I go visit mushroom friend for dinner. Ackaaa – sea so short now, can see clear to bottom. Like, how happen? All my life I live with tall sea. Now sea tall as my full-stretched wings. Many big animal gone now (shove off buttbiters). All leave to find taller water. New animal replace them in huge number – eel, catfish, salamander, frog, beaver, turtle, crab, coral and many snail, some big as human child! Island humans now tie sticks to legs to walk above water. Ha, they learn stick-walking so fast! They good at nets and thrusting sharp poles – spear so many things swimming around them. They wear cloth cover over mouth. Seems they not like new odors of shallow water. Smell like old fish mixed with moss slop and dookie. I not mind. Aaaah! There is my friend!
